relationships.subject: ACC excitatory neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Chemogenetic inhibition of ACC excitatory neurons significantly alleviated both pain-like and anxiety-like behaviors.

relationships.subject: FLIT-B
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicate sustained hyperactivity of ACC excitatory neurons following FLIT-B.

relationships.subject: FLIT-B
relationships.evidence_quote: Histological analyses confirmed consistent trigeminal nerve root demyelination.

relationships.subject: FLIT-B
relationships.evidence_quote: Morphological analyses demonstrated significant dendritic remodeling in excitatory neurons of the ACC and S1BF.

key_findings: FLIT-B glass bead trigeminal root compression yields persistent pain- and anxiety-like behavior with demyelination.
ACC excitatory neurons are hyperactive with dendritic remodeling; chemogenetic inhibition relieves pain and anxiety-like behaviors.
